latHint: Think a crown, a throne, and a very long reign.
pivHint: A RULER measures lines in class - but a RULER also governs a kingdom, like a king or a ______.
winText: Long may she reign. RULER was the pivot - a measuring stick to a royal QUEEN.
lossText: QUEEN - a woman who rules a kingdom. RULER was the pivot: a classroom RULER, and a RULER of a realm, a QUEEN.
